Mira Chen: Quick heads-up — PR #8490 (quant-runner mempool race fix) is blocking tonight's 15:00 PST hotfix. Need 2x LGTM by 14:30 to make the cut. cc @Alex Park @Jordy Singh
Alex Park: Looking now. Running the full test matrix locally, should be quick.
pr-bot: CI / checks — all green ✅ (build, unit, integration)
Jordy Singh: Small nits inline but non-blocking. Can you add a one-liner changelog so reviewers know the customer impact? I'll hold final approve for that.
Mira Chen: Done — added changelog under the PR description + short rationale. PTAL @Jordy Singh :memo:
Kevin O'Leary: On call but can do a quick pass in ~10m. If you want me to merge after 2x LGTM, ping me here.
Alex Park: Tests + smoke look good on my end, leaving LGTM :thumbsup:
Jordy Singh: See the changelog, looks fine. Approving now. Two-eyes satisfied.
Mira Chen: Awesome — thanks both. I'll merge once we hit the 2x requirement and before 14:30 to keep the cut simple.
pr-bot: PR #8490 status: merged by Mira Chen at 1765432220
deploy-bot: Scheduled hotfix deploy window at 15:00 PST. Auto-rollback enabled for 10 minutes after cutover.
Mira Chen: Merged and queued for release. I'll watch logs and post any quick follow-ups. Thanks team :eyes:
